name: high capacity high current half inch spark insect wand
description:
A low noise Zoom H2 recording of a strongly charged, high current, half inch spark insect wand.  The recorder was placed approximately 18" away and set on nearly the lowest setting so that the sound wouldn't overload the input as the spark wand is a loud device!  It's purpose is to extinguish bald-faced, European, and similar hornets or other large, threatening intruders. 

There are individual discharges here along with continuous ones.  Exhibits more bass than most of the other sparking devices I've uploaded.  

Sound effects applications and/or substitution of sparking devices with poor audio.

name: Military Aircraft Flyovers_Multiple Craft.wav
description: This is a recording I did a few years ago with my low end handheld recorder before I got my Zoom H4n. The audio is of a local air show of the Blue Angels including other aircraft. The first flyover is an Apache Helicopter. Second is a F22 Raptor flyover. Third is 4 F18 Hornets (Blue Angels) flying over. Forth is another 4 F18 Hornets flying over. Fifth is another angle of the 4 F18 Hornets flying over. Last are 2 F18 Hornets flying over. The day was very windy so there is some wind distortion. I edited in Reaper adding EG, Slight reverb, and noise reduction. Enjoy. JB.

name: Jet Fighter Views (Cockpit, Outside) During Liftoff, Flight and Landing.flac
description: Original video description: DEPLOYMENT (Jan-July 2011) A look into sorties flown in an F/A-18F Super Hornet assigned to the Checkmates of Strike Fighter Squadron (VFA) 211 during a deployment aboard the aircraft carrier USS Enterprise (CVN 65). The aircraft carrier and Carrier Air Wing (CVW) 1 were on a deployment conducting maritime security operations in the U.S. 5th and 6th Fleet areas of responsibility. (U.S. Navy video by Lt. Ian Schmidt/Released). Extracted from a video () by a US Government agency, thus public domain. Find many more military sounds in my military sounds pack, also located on Freesound. Contact me if you have interest in specific sounds for open source or commercial purpose.
